name: AZINO
description:
Act as an expert Frontend Web Developer and UI/UX Designer. Create a clean, lightweight, practical, and production-ready e-commerce single-page website for an Iranian imitation jewelry store named "آذینو" (Azino).

The website must be fully Persian (Farsi) with strict Right-to-Left (RTL) layout and use the "Vazirmatn" Google Font for crisp, modern Persian typography.

Design & Aesthetic Inspiration (Inspired by minimalist luxury branding):
- Color Palette: Warm off-white/cream background (#FAF8F5), deep charcoal/matte black primary text (#1C1C1C), muted taupe/gray secondary text (#6E6A63), and refined champagne gold accents (#C5A059) for buttons, borders, and highlights.
- Animations & Feel: Keep the animations lightweight, smooth, and tasteful—avoid heavy or overly flashy effects that slow down performance. Use subtle CSS transitions on hover (gentle image zoom, soft button elevation) and clean fade-in animations on scroll.

Keep the architecture simple, modular, and easy to maintain or expand later (MVP approach) so it can be hosted immediately on static hosting (like GitHub Pages) without complex backend dependencies.

Please generate the complete, single-file HTML code (with embedded CSS using Tailwind CSS CDN and clean Vanilla JavaScript) containing:

1. Minimal Sticky Header:
   - Brand logo text: "آذینو | Azino" in an elegant font style.
   - Simple category filter links: همه محصولات (All), گردنبند (Necklaces), دستبند (Bracelets), انگشتر (Rings), گوشواره (Earrings).
   - Shopping cart icon with live item counter badge.

2. Clean & Focused Hero Banner:
   - A compact, tasteful banner (not overly tall) with a warm minimalist background or subtle jewelry aesthetic.
   - Headline: "درخشش در جزئیات، امضای استایل شما"
   - Subheadline: "مجموعه‌ای منتخب از بدلیجات خاص و ضدحساسیت برای استایل روزمره و مجلسی"
   - Single sleek CTA button ("مشاهده محصولات") that smoothly scrolls to the product catalog.

3. Interactive Product Catalog (Easy to Edit):
   - Store product data in a clean, well-commented JavaScript array at the top of the `<script>` tag so I can easily add, edit, or remove products, prices (in تومان), and image URLs myself.
   - Include 6 realistic sample jewelry items across the categories.
   - Category filter buttons that dynamically filter products without page reloads.
   - Clean product cards with: high-quality placeholder image, title, category tag, price in Toman (formatted with Persian/comma separators), and a simple "افزودن به سبد خرید" button.

4. Practical Shopping Cart Drawer & Quick Order:
   - Slide-over cart sidebar from the left (suitable for RTL).
   - Ability to increase/decrease item quantities, remove items, and see the live total price in Toman.
   - Simple, practical checkout flow for a starting store: customer enters Name, Phone Number, and Address, and clicks "ثبت سفارش نهایی" (which formats the order summary cleanly and offers a direct link/action to send the order via WhatsApp or copy the invoice).

5. Trust Badges & Simple Footer:
   - 3 minimal icon blocks: "ضمانت ثبات رنگ", "ارسال سریع به سراسر کشور", "بسته‌بندی کادویی شیک".
   - Clean footer with Instagram/Telegram/WhatsApp links and copyright for "فروشگاه بدلیجات آذینو".

Technical Requirements:
- Use semantic HTML5, Tailwind CSS (via CDN), and clean, commented Vanilla JavaScript.
- Ensure 100% mobile responsiveness (especially optimized for mobile shoppers).
- Output the complete, error-free code inside a single HTML code block.
